newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-LEAFS, FLYERS FINED TOTAL OF $12,000 FOR BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-LEAFS, FLYERS FINED TOTAL OF $12,000 FOR BRAWL.

text.p: The National Hockey League Wednesday handed down fines totalling $12,000 stemming from a huge brawl at the end of the Toronto Maple Leafs-Philadelphia Flyers game Sunday night.

Each team was fined $5,000, while Maple Leafs right wing Tie Domi and Flyers left wing Scott Daniels were fined $1,000 each for their altercation with eight seconds remaining in the contest in Philadelphia.

Maple Leafs left wing Wendel Clark and goaltender Felix Potvin and Flyers centre Daniel Lacroix and goaltender Ron Hextall all received major penalties for fighting as well as various misconducts and minors for the altercations.
"It's all part of the game, part of sticking up for your team," said Potvin, who traded punches with Hextall.

"It's happened before and I'm sure it'll happen again. I saw Lacroix charging (Larry) Murphy, I was trying to stick up for him," he added. "I happened to look down the ice and Hexy was coming down, I just tried to get ready for him."
